independence: The reviewer authored none of the protocol, cohort, models, masks, evaluation, runner, transfer, robustness, or external adapter implementations.
scope: Exact core protocol, configuration, GAVD cohort, and implementation; fixed transfer and robustness dependencies are accepted for execution after their data prerequisites pass. No empirical result or publication acceptance is implied.
checks: Initial independent execution: 57 tests passed in 19.63 seconds.
Final runner/transfer/robustness execution after cohort guard: 16 tests passed in 18.58 seconds.
Reviewer-written real-structure and synthetic-arithmetic checks passed; no real efficacy outcomes were inspected.
All 14 cohort artifacts, 96 raw source-pose caches and 96 actual source-video hashes verified.
Future-containing predictor input rejected; hidden and naturally missing values do not affect fixed-mask predictions.
All 15 nested source schedules exclude calibration and outer groups from all contributing fits.
Paired bootstrap matched an explicit source-resampling reconstruction.
Participant/recording hierarchy precedes nonlinear transfer calibration.

resolved_findings.issue: Unequal inner-fold means changed source weights.
resolved_findings.resolution: Selection pools one held-out error per source; independent numerical replay and regression test pass.

resolved_findings.issue: Accepted freeze did not bind requested run configuration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Real entry compares normalized config before loading or fitting; refusal test passes.

resolved_findings.issue: A different self-validating cohort could reuse an approved method identity.
resolved_findings.resolution: Identity and membership hashes are checked against freeze before data loading; refusal test passes.

required_next_gates: Coordinator writes an immutable accepted protocol freeze with the exact configuration, cohort and implementation identities above before real outer fitting.
Pin separate transfer and robustness dependencies before those analyses execute.
Complete external extraction attrition, independent reconstruction, and blinded observation/identity QA before external efficacy scores.
Record all attempted arms, failures, resource limits and extension-gate decisions.
Independently reconstruct actual source/participant results and inspect generated notebooks, manuscript pages and slide pages before final acceptance.
interpretation_limits: GAVD source reuse remains exploratory; source IDs are not verified patient IDs.
Current components are singletons; multi-source components are explicitly rejected.
OOF nuisance predictions come from smaller fit pools than final R predictors; the coarse reference is an approximation.
Intervals condition on saved fits, not the entire training pipeline, and no clinical or conformal guarantee follows.
External coded participants and severity annotations remain dataset metadata; unknown cross-dataset person overlap cannot be disproved by file hashes.
A software acceptance does not establish masking, anomaly-detection, physiological or clinical efficacy.
